actions.action: Check whether the planter has a drainage hole
Take 4–6 pilea stem-tip cuttings and root them on damp mix or in water
Water the planter the day before separating
Remove the rootball and tease the pilea clump away
Pot the pilea into an 8–10 cm pot with a drainage hole, using houseplant mix and perlite
Place the pilea in bright, indirect light
Water the pilea when the top 1 cm of soil is dry
Pot the kalanchoe in cactus mix
Move the kalanchoe to the brightest spot
Water the kalanchoe only when the soil is fully dry

reason: The thread's fix was rearranging the plants so the kalanchoe gets the most light; the answer says nothing is wrong and only mentions giving the kalanchoe the brightest spot at the end, among separation advice that does no harm.
